description: Start a durable long-running backtest and return immediately with an operation_id. Poll get_backtest_operation; API restarts can be recovered with resume_backtest_operation.

bars.description: Historical bars; interval-specific limits apply and are validated locally.

idempotency_key.description: Optional fxbt operation key. Felix generates one when omitted.

strategy_id.description: Owned strategy UUID returned by generate_strategy.

years.description: Historical years. Overrides bars; use interval=1d for up to 40 years.

name: start_backtest
